raw.details:
EDXcellence invites students across India to participate in the National Online Hackathon 2026, a free online coding and innovation challenge designed to encourage technical skills, creativity, teamwork, and real-world problem-solving.

Hackathon Tracks

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
  • Data Science and Analytics
  • Full-Stack Web Development
  • Cybersecurity and Ethical Hacking
  • Internet of Things (IoT) and Robotics
  • Open Innovation and Technology Solutions

Eligibility

  • Open to undergraduate and postgraduate students across India.
  • Students from B.Tech, B.E., BCA, MCA, B.Sc., and other relevant disciplines are welcome.
  • Beginners and experienced developers can participate.
  • Participants may register individually or in teams of 2–4 members.

Registration Fee: Completely FREE.

Format: Online, pan-India participation.

Participation Process

  • Complete the official registration process.
  • Select a hackathon track and identify a problem to solve.
  • Develop an original project or working prototype.
  • Submit the project within the announced deadline.
  • Eligible submissions will be evaluated based on innovation, technical implementation, problem-solving, usability, and presentation.

Rules and Guidelines

  • Participants must provide accurate registration details.
  • Projects must be original, and third-party resources must be appropriately credited.
  • Plagiarism, fraudulent participation, and copied work presented as original may lead to disqualification.
  • Participants must follow applicable laws, software licences, and ethical development practices.
  • Project submission instructions, deadlines, and final event guidelines will be communicated by the organisers.

Perks and Benefits

For Winners

  • Free access to the EdXcellence Premium Internship Program worth ₹9,999.
  • Free access to the Vedic Intelligence Program, including lifetime mentorship.
  • Certificates recognising achievements.
  • Letter of Recommendation (LOR), subject to the organiser's eligibility and verification criteria.

For All Participants

  • Free access to the EdXcellence Internship Training Program worth ₹2,999.
  • Free access to the Vedic Intelligence Program, including lifetime mentorship.
  • Certificate of Participation for eligible participants who participate in the hackathon.

Exclusive Discount

  • A 90% discount coupon code for eligible EdXcellence programs will be provided to participants, subject to applicable terms and validity.

Important Conditions

  • Registration and participation are free; no payment is required to enter the hackathon.
  • Complimentary programs and mentorship are subject to the scope and terms communicated by EdXcellence LLP.
  • Winners will be determined through the official evaluation process.
  • Participation does not guarantee employment, a paid internship, or a stipend.

Organiser: EdXcellence LLP

Website: https://edxcellence.org.in/

Date:  November 1st week onwards as per participants the date will be announced in the month.

Register for FREE and turn your innovative ideas into impactful technology solutions.
